outcome: RIG-1 expression in syncytiotrophoblast of placental villi
RIG-1 expression in the endothelium of villous capillaries
cohort: Women of reproductive age with early- and late-onset preeclampsia and cesarean delivery at 27-39 weeks of gestation, and women with uncomplicated full-term pregnancies
finding: The highest expression of RIG-1 was found in the syncytiotrophoblast of placental villi in the group with uncomplicated full-term pregnancy (normal); RIG-1 expression in groups with early- and late-onset preeclampsia was significantly (p<0.01) lower.
